sentences.text:
For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Tapeshwar Sharma
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sandeep Kumar
 Oral Order
4 08-10-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
2. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Vaishali P.S. Case No. 213 of 2022 registered for the offence under Sections 376, 302/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, the petitioner is said to have committed rape and murder of the deceased.
4. The petitioner is in custody since 9.11.2024.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent as after investigation,
the police has submitted charge-sheet under Section 306 of the IPC.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts, this application is allowed.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.29743 of 2025(4) dt.08-10-2025 7.

Let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned CJM, Vaishali Rahul Sahni vs The State Of Bihar on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59286186/
1 at Hajipur/concerned Court below in connection with Vaishali P.S. Case No. 213 of 2022.
